title: Also sprach Zarathustra: Sunrise

legal_notes: FLAG composer term: Richard Strauss died 1949. This tone poem was published in 1896, so the composition is PD-US (published before 1930) and PD in life+70 countries since 1 Jan 2020. Later Strauss works are not the same. The recording is Kevin MacLeod's performance, file metadata and the Commons page say CC BY 3.0. Required credit: Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Source page links incompetech. Not a Vienna Philharmonic recording.
